testName: Client Life Events & Financial Goals Progress Tracking
steps:
1. Open Person Account "Claire Sterling"
2. Locate Life Events component on record page
3. Click "Add Event" on "Retirement" icon
4. Enter Event Date as 5 years from today and click Save
5. Scroll to Financial Goals related list and click New
6. Enter Goal Name "Early Retirement Nest Egg"
7. Enter Target Amount "$1,200,000" and Target Date
8. Enter Actual Amount "$850,000"
9. Click on Save button
10. Verify Financial Goal progress bar renders 70.8% completed on client 360 view
